profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc. describes itself as the leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation. Its website states that the world's most influential organizations trust Pega to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. The company says its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight from the start, and that Pega Platform provides unified, predictable, and safe AI for mission-critical work. It also describes Pega Blueprint as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together.

The company says it has delivered a platform to reimagine, run, and evolve enterprise processes and decisions since 1983, combining AI with architecture to keep mission-critical operations governed, scalable, and continuously adaptable.

Public records identify Pegasystems Inc. as a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker PEGA, with SEC CIK 0001013857. The available litigation data shows no individual case records, while Massachusetts legal exposure records list 191 entries under the company's name.
